title: Merge sort procedure indices
statement: A program $P$ together with four natural-number indices $p_{\mathrm{sort}},p_{\mathrm{half}},p_{\mathrm{merge}},p_{\mathrm{copy}}$ has the required procedure layout when its entries at those indices are, respectively, the sorting body parameterized by these four indices, the halving body, the merging body, and the copying body.
hypotheses_covered: The program entry at the sorting index is the specified sorting body.
The program entry at the halving index is the specified halving body.
The program entry at the merging index is the specified merging body.
The program entry at the copying index is the specified copying body.
caveat: The formal statement refers to the halving, merging, and copying bodies, but their definitions are not included in the supplied material.
